# `oortmem` API reference

<!-- Generated by `pnpm docs:reference` (scripts/sdk-reference.mjs). Do not edit: `pnpm verify` fails when it is out of date. -->

Every name the `oortmem` 0.6.1 package exports from `oortmem` and `oortmem/ai-sdk`, as its
published type declarations state it. The guide, with tested examples, is [sdk.md](sdk.md);
the stability promise is in [sdk.md#stability](sdk.md#stability).

## `oortmem`

`oortmem`: Oort memory from code (CON-108). `createOort()` gives a handle whose scope is fixed;
it runs the engine in this process (`local`) or calls Oort Cloud (`cloud`). This root export
never loads the CLI (commander, prompts, colours), and cloud mode loads no native module.

```ts
import { createOort, formatForPrompt } from 'oortmem';
const oort = await createOort();
const r = await oort.recall('how do we deploy?');
console.log(formatForPrompt(r));
await oort.observe({ user: 'We deploy on Fridays now.', assistant: 'Noted.' });
```

**Functions:** [`createOort`](#oortmem-createoort), [`formatForPrompt`](#oortmem-formatforprompt)

**Constants:** [`VERSION`](#oortmem-version)

**Classes:** [`OortError`](#oortmem-oorterror), [`OortAmbiguousIdError`](#oortmem-oortambiguousiderror), [`OortCloudOnlyError`](#oortmem-oortcloudonlyerror), [`OortInternalError`](#oortmem-oortinternalerror), [`OortNeedsConfirmationError`](#oortmem-oortneedsconfirmationerror), [`OortNeedsKeyError`](#oortmem-oortneedskeyerror), [`OortNeedsLoginError`](#oortmem-oortneedsloginerror), [`OortNetworkError`](#oortmem-oortnetworkerror), [`OortNotFoundError`](#oortmem-oortnotfounderror), [`OortRefusedError`](#oortmem-oortrefusederror), [`OortUsageError`](#oortmem-oortusageerror)

### Functions

<a id="oortmem-createoort"></a>

#### `createOort`

A handle on Oort memory. `mode: 'auto'` (the default) uses what `oort setup` chose on this
machine; servers pass `mode`, `home`, `org`, `project`, `projectConfig: false` and `keySources`
explicitly. Makes no network request; local mode opens the store and loads the adapters.

```ts
export declare function createOort(options?: OortOptions): Promise<Oort>;
```

<a id="oortmem-formatforprompt"></a>

#### `formatForPrompt`

A recall's memories as the `<oort-memory>` block the hooks inject, within `budgetChars`
(default: the recall's `budgetChars`, else the config's, else 6000): block tags and label brackets in memory text are escaped, so a stored memory
cannot close the block or forge a label, and each text is scrubbed again. Inject memory into a
prompt only through this.

```ts
export declare function formatForPrompt(r: RecallResult, opts?: {
  budgetChars?: number;
}): string;
```

<a id="oortmem-oorterror"></a>

#### `OortError`

```ts
export declare class OortError extends Error {
  readonly code: OortErrorCode;
  /** A runnable `oort …` command where one fixes it, else null. */
  readonly fix: string | null;
  /** A finer, stable string (`principal-required`, `daily-limit`, …). */
  readonly reason?: string;
  /** The HTTP status (cloud). */
  readonly status?: number;
  readonly retryable: boolean;
  /** Seconds the service asked to wait before a retry (`Retry-After`), when it said. */
  readonly retryAfter?: number;
  constructor(code: OortErrorCode, message: string, opts?: OortErrorOptions);
}
```

### Interfaces and types

<a id="oortmem-modelrole"></a>

#### `ModelRole`

```ts
export type ModelRole = 'embed' | 'rerank' | 'decide' | 'write';
```

<a id="oortmem-oorterrorcode"></a>

#### `OortErrorCode`

The SDK's errors (CON-108 §5): the ten `oort.v1` codes as classes, each with a stable `reason`.
Built on the CLI's `describeError` (one table for both), without its CLI-only fixes (`--yes`,
`oort --help`). Messages name fields, never their values, and never carry a key.

```ts
export type OortErrorCode = 'usage' | 'not-found' | 'ambiguous-id' | 'needs-key' | 'needs-login' | 'needs-confirmation' | 'cloud-only' | 'network' | 'refused' | 'internal';
```

<a id="oortmem-oortmode"></a>

#### `OortMode`

`auto`: the store `oort setup` chose on this machine (`$OORT_HOME/cloud.json`), else local.

```ts
export type OortMode = 'auto' | 'local' | 'cloud';
```

<a id="oortmem-keysource"></a>

#### `KeySource`

Where a key may come from: given in code, the environment, or the Keychain (credentials.json).

```ts
export type KeySource = 'explicit' | 'env' | 'keychain';
```

<a id="oortmem-oortkeys"></a>

#### `OortKeys`

Keys given in code. Held in memory only; never written, logged or put into an error.

```ts
export interface OortKeys {
  voyage?: string;
  typesafe?: string;
  anthropic?: string;
  /** The Oort key: cloud mode, or the Oort Pro relay for a role with no vendor key. */
  oort?: string;
}
```

<a id="oortmem-judgerole"></a>

#### `JudgeRole`

Who records judgments through this handle (§6.3).

```ts
export type JudgeRole = 'agent' | 'expert';
```

<a id="oortmem-oortconfigoverlay"></a>

#### `OortConfigOverlay`

A deep partial of the home config, laid over the resolved config (local mode). Checked against
the config's strict schema when the handle is created: an unknown key is a usage error. `serve`
cannot be set from code.

```ts
export interface OortConfigOverlay {
  embed?: {
    provider?: string;
    model?: string;
    dimension?: number;
    [key: string]: unknown;
  };
  rerank?: {
    provider?: string;
    model?: string;
    [key: string]: unknown;
  };
  decide?: {
    provider?: string;
    [key: string]: unknown;
  };
  writer?: {
    provider?: string;
    model?: string;
    [key: string]: unknown;
  };
  activation?: Record<string, unknown>;
  recall?: Record<string, unknown>;
  project?: {
    private?: boolean;
  };
  /** Who counts as an expert (the host's code is the operator here). */
  judge?: {
    experts?: string[];
    operator?: string;
  };
}
```

<a id="oortmem-oortoptions"></a>

#### `OortOptions`

```ts
export interface OortOptions {
  /** Default `auto`. */
  mode?: OortMode;
  /** `OORT_HOME`, else `~/.oort` (local, auto). */
  home?: string;
  /** Used only to find the project and its config; default `process.cwd()`. */
  cwd?: string;
  /**
   * The project: an id (`cfg:<id>`, as `oort project link`), `null` for global memories only, or
   * omitted to derive it from `cwd` exactly as the CLI does.
   */
  project?: string | null;
  /** `false` skips the repository's `oort.config.json` (a server whose cwd is a checkout); local and cloud. */
  projectConfig?: boolean;
  /** The agent to act as; default `OORT_AGENT`, else anonymous (the Planet only). */
  agent?: string;
  /** An end user (local mode). Requires `org`, not `local`. Their Planet only, never a Star. */
  user?: string;
  /** The tenant (local mode); default `local`. */
  org?: string;
  /** Keys given in code (local; cloud takes `oort` only). */
  keys?: OortKeys;
  /** Default all three; `keychain` is dropped when `OORT_NO_KEYCHAIN=1`. */
  keySources?: readonly KeySource[];
  /** Laid over the resolved config (local mode). */
  config?: OortConfigOverlay;
  /** Oort Cloud's URL (cloud mode); default `OORT_CLOUD_URL`, else `https://api.oortcloud.dev`. */
  url?: string;
  /** Per request, cloud mode; default 30 000. */
  timeoutMs?: number;
  /** Default true. `false` refuses an older store (`refused`, `migration-required`). */
  migrate?: boolean;
  /** Default `process.env`. */
  env?: Record<string, string | undefined>;
  /** The fetch cloud mode uses; default the keep-alive pool. */
  fetch?: typeof fetch;
  /** Default `{ role: 'agent' }`. */
  judge?: {
    role: JudgeRole;
    operator?: string;
  };
}
```

<a id="oortmem-judgmentview"></a>

#### `JudgmentView`

A judgment as a memory carries it (local mode).

```ts
export interface JudgmentView {
  subject: {
    summary: string;
    ref?: string;
  };
  verdict: string;
  verdicts: string[];
  reason: string;
  criteria: string[];
  domain: string;
  by: string;
  decidedAt: string;
  /** `mcp`: recorded by an agent (MCP, or an SDK in agent role). `sdk`: by expert-role SDK code. */
  via: JudgmentVia;
  status: MemoryStatus;
  /** A person recorded it, or confirmed an agent's record of it. */
  confirmed: boolean;
  /** Recorded by an agent and not confirmed: judging leaves it out by default. */
  agentRecorded: boolean;
  withdrawn?: {
    at: string;
    by: string;
  };
  pack?: {
    id: string;
    name: string;
  };
}
```

<a id="oortmem-oort"></a>

#### `Oort`

A handle on Oort memory, its scope fixed when it was made (`createOort`, `scoped`).

```ts
export interface Oort {
  readonly mode: 'local' | 'cloud';
  readonly judge: OortJudge;
  recall(query: string, opts?: RecallOptions): Promise<RecallResult>;
  observe(turn: Turn, opts?: {
    signal?: AbortSignal;
  }): Promise<ObserveResult>;
  remember(facts: string | readonly string[], opts?: {
    type?: MemoryType;
  }): Promise<RememberResult>;
  forget(id: string, opts?: {
    everywhere?: boolean;
  }): Promise<ForgetResult>;
  pin(id: string): Promise<PinResult>;
  unpin(id: string): Promise<PinResult>;
  recent(opts?: {
    since?: string | Date;
    limit?: number;
  }): Promise<{
    memories: MemoryView[];
    warnings: Warning[];
  }>;
  explain(id: string): Promise<Explanation>;
  whoami(): Promise<Whoami>;
  /** Local only. */
  consolidate(opts?: {
    budgetMs?: number;
    signal?: AbortSignal;
  }): Promise<ConsolidateResult>;
  /** A derived handle sharing this one's engine; its scope is fixed. */
  scoped(s: ScopedOptions): Oort;
  close(): Promise<void>;
  [Symbol.asyncDispose](): Promise<void>;
}
```

## `oortmem/ai-sdk`

`oortmem/ai-sdk`: Oort memory for the Vercel AI SDK (CON-108 §11).

**@experimental** May change in any minor release.

- `oortTools(oort)` gives `{ recall, remember, forget }` to pass as `tools` to `generateText` or
  `streamText` (with `{ judge: true }`, also `judge` and `record_judgment`). Each is the plain
  `{ description, inputSchema, execute }` object `tool()` returns (`tool()` has no runtime
  behaviour), so this module never imports `ai`.
- `oortObserve(oort, prompt)` returns an `onEnd` callback (`onFinish` before AI SDK 7) that
  saves the turn.
- `oortInstructions(oort, query)` returns the `<oort-memory>` block for `instructions` (`system`
  before AI SDK 7).

Rules: tools act in the agent role only (`scoped({ judgeRole: 'agent' })`), memory reaches the
model only through `formatForPrompt`, and the judgment tools never take `includeAgentRecorded`
or `includeImported`, so a model cannot widen what counts as precedent.

**Functions:** [`oortTools`](#oortmem-ai-sdk-oorttools), [`oortObserve`](#oortmem-ai-sdk-oortobserve), [`oortInstructions`](#oortmem-ai-sdk-oortinstructions)

**Interfaces and types:** [`OortTool`](#oortmem-ai-sdk-oorttool), [`OortToolsOptions`](#oortmem-ai-sdk-oorttoolsoptions), [`OortToolSet`](#oortmem-ai-sdk-oorttoolset)

### Functions

<a id="oortmem-ai-sdk-oorttools"></a>

#### `oortTools`

**@experimental** The Oort tools for `generateText` / `streamText`, in the agent role.

```ts
export declare function oortTools(oort: Oort, opts?: OortToolsOptions): OortToolSet;
```

<a id="oortmem-ai-sdk-oortobserve"></a>

#### `oortObserve`

**@experimental** An `onEnd` callback (`onFinish` before AI SDK 7) that saves the turn: the user's
prompt and the model's final text. Await the generation in a serverless function, so the save
finishes before the runtime freezes. A failure to save never fails the generation; `onError`
hears about it.

```ts
export declare function oortObserve(oort: Oort, prompt: string | (() => string), opts?: {
  turnRef?: string;
  onError?: (e: unknown) => void;
}): (event: {
  text?: string;
  finalStep?: {
    text?: string;
  };
}) => Promise<void>;
```

<a id="oortmem-ai-sdk-oortinstructions"></a>

#### `oortInstructions`

**@experimental** The `<oort-memory>` block for `query`, to put in `instructions` (`system` before
AI SDK 7). Empty when nothing relevant is remembered.

```ts
export declare function oortInstructions(oort: Oort, query: string, opts?: Pick<RecallOptions, 'limit' | 'speed' | 'budgetChars'>): Promise<string>;
```

### Interfaces and types

<a id="oortmem-ai-sdk-oorttool"></a>

#### `OortTool`

A tool as the AI SDK takes it (the shape `tool()` returns).

```ts
export interface OortTool<I, O> {
  description: string;
  inputSchema: z.ZodType<I>;
  execute: (input: I, options?: unknown) => Promise<O>;
}
```

<a id="oortmem-ai-sdk-oorttoolsoptions"></a>

#### `OortToolsOptions`

```ts
export interface OortToolsOptions {
  /** Also offer `judge` and `record_judgment` (agent role). Default false. */
  judge?: boolean;
  /** Most memories one recall returns to the model (1 to 50). Default 8. */
  recallLimit?: number;
  /** The block budget for recalled memory, in characters. Default the recall's. */
  budgetChars?: number;
}
```

<a id="oortmem-ai-sdk-oorttoolset"></a>

#### `OortToolSet`

A type alias, not an interface, so it is assignable to the AI SDK's `ToolSet` (an index
signature): `tools: oortTools(oort)` typechecks without a spread.

```ts
export type OortToolSet = {
  recall: OortTool<Infer<typeof RecallInput>, {
    memory: string;
    abstained: boolean;
  }>;
  remember: OortTool<Infer<typeof RememberInput>, {
    results: unknown[];
  }>;
  forget: OortTool<Infer<typeof ForgetInput>, {
    forgotten: string;
  }>;
  judge?: OortTool<Infer<typeof JudgeInput>, Record<string, unknown>>;
  record_judgment?: OortTool<Infer<typeof RecordJudgmentInput>, Record<string, unknown>>;
};
```

`Infer` is not exported from `oortmem/ai-sdk`; `OortToolSet` uses it:

```ts
type Infer<T extends z.ZodType> = z.infer<T>;
```

`RecallInput` is not exported from `oortmem/ai-sdk`; `OortToolSet` uses it:

```ts
declare const RecallInput: z.ZodObject<{
  query: z.ZodString;
  asOf: z.ZodOptional<z.ZodString>;
}, z.core.$strict>;
```

`RememberInput` is not exported from `oortmem/ai-sdk`; `OortToolSet` uses it:

```ts
declare const RememberInput: z.ZodObject<{
  facts: z.ZodArray<z.ZodString>;
  type: z.ZodOptional<z.ZodEnum<{
    episodic: "episodic";
    preference: "preference";
    procedural: "procedural";
    semantic: "semantic";
  }>>;
}, z.core.$strict>;
```

`ForgetInput` is not exported from `oortmem/ai-sdk`; `OortToolSet` uses it:

```ts
declare const ForgetInput: z.ZodObject<{
  id: z.ZodString;
}, z.core.$strict>;
```

`JudgeInput` is not exported from `oortmem/ai-sdk`; `OortToolSet` uses it:

```ts
declare const JudgeInput: z.ZodObject<{
  item: z.ZodString;
  details: z.ZodOptional<z.ZodString>;
  domain: z.ZodOptional<z.ZodString>;
  by: z.ZodOptional<z.ZodString>;
}, z.core.$strict>;
```

`RecordJudgmentInput` is not exported from `oortmem/ai-sdk`; `OortToolSet` uses it:

```ts
declare const RecordJudgmentInput: z.ZodObject<{
  subject: z.ZodString;
  verdict: z.ZodString;
  reason: z.ZodString;
  domain: z.ZodString;
  by: z.ZodString;
  ref: z.ZodOptional<z.ZodString>;
}, z.core.$strict>;
```
